# CLI reference

This page is generated recursively from the installed `torchsky` argument parser.

## `torchsky`

```text
usage: torchsky [-h] [--version] {map,sky,viz} ...

Torch-native celestial geometry, sphere, and mapmaking workflows.

positional arguments:
  {map,sky,viz}
    map          High-SNR sky map: coadd (SWarp/drizzle-like) or continuous
                 field render
    sky          Sky background estimation and multi-exposure matching.
    viz          Start the torchsky web visualization server.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --version      show program's version number and exit

Examples:
  torchsky --version
  torchsky map --help
  torchsky sky estimate --help
```

## `torchsky map`

```text
usage: torchsky map [-h] [--dry-run] [--plan-json PATH] [--from-plan PATH]
                    [--scratch-dir SCRATCH_DIR]
                    [--output-planes {SCI,WHT,IVAR,CTX,MASK,NEXP,NCORR,DQ} [{SCI,WHT,IVAR,CTX,MASK,NEXP,NCORR,DQ} ...]]
                    [--method {coadd,field}]
                    [--workflow {native,drizzle,swarp,montage}] [--hdu HDU]
                    [--weights [WEIGHTS ...]]
                    [--photometric-scales [PHOTOMETRIC_SCALES ...]]
                    [--background-offsets [BACKGROUND_OFFSETS ...]]
                    [--background-mode {none,per-exposure,overlap}]
                    [--sky-method {mesh,polynomial}]
                    [--sky-statistic {median,huber,tukey}]
                    [--sky-block-size SKY_BLOCK_SIZE]
                    [--sky-mesh-filter {median,gaussian,none}]
                    [--sky-mesh-filter-size SKY_MESH_FILTER_SIZE]
                    [--sky-interpolate {bilinear,bicubic}]
                    [--sky-order SKY_ORDER] [--weight-maps [WEIGHT_MAPS ...]]
                    [--weight-map-hdu WEIGHT_MAP_HDU]
                    [--mask-maps [MASK_MAPS ...]]
                    [--mask-map-hdu MASK_MAP_HDU] [--dq-maps [DQ_MAPS ...]]
                    [--dq-hdu HDU] [--good-bits MASK]
                    [--primary-beam-maps [PRIMARY_BEAM_MAPS ...]]
                    [--primary-beam-hdu PRIMARY_BEAM_HDU]
                    [--reference REFERENCE] [--reference-hdu REFERENCE_HDU]
                    [--plan-reference PLAN_REFERENCE]
                    [--stack {weighted_mean,mean,median,sigma_clipped}]
                    [--clip-sigma CLIP_SIGMA]
                    [--clip-iterations CLIP_ITERATIONS]
                    [--kernel {nearest,bilinear,bicubic,lanczos3,lanczos5,mitchell_netravali,catmull_rom,fft_shift,fft_diagonal_affine,periodic_linear_affine,fft_linear_affine,drizzle_point,drizzle_square,conservative_polygon}]
                    [--drizzle-pixfrac DRIZZLE_PIXFRAC]
                    [--value-semantics {surface_brightness,flux}]
                    [--auto-tile | --no-auto-tile] [--tile-pixels TILE_PIXELS]
                    [--tile-above-megapixels TILE_ABOVE_MEGAPIXELS]
                    [--field-preset {fast,balanced,spectral,operator_constrained}]
                    [--field-amp {none,float16,bfloat16}]
                    [--field-model MODEL] [--artifact ARTIFACT]
                    [--resume RESUME] [--field-band BAND]
                    [--field-spectral-source {svo,builtin,file,gaussian}]
                    [--svo-facility SVO_FACILITY]
                    [--svo-instrument SVO_INSTRUMENT] [--svo-filter-id ID]
                    [--svo-prefer {classic,2025,any}]
                    [--svo-cache-dir SVO_CACHE_DIR] [--no-svo-cache]
                    [--field-transmission PATH] [--field-transmission-dir DIR]
                    [--field-transmission-unit {angstrom,nm}]
                    [--field-gaussian-lambda-eff ANGSTROM]
                    [--field-gaussian-lambda-min ANGSTROM]
                    [--field-gaussian-lambda-max ANGSTROM]
                    [--field-gaussian-sigma ANGSTROM] [--field-quiet-svo]
                    [--field-steps N] [--field-lr RATE]
                    [--field-patch-size PIXELS] [--field-patches-per-obs N]
                    [--field-obs-per-step N] [--field-spectral-samples N]
                    [--field-spatial-sampling {center,gauss_legendre_2x2}]
                    [--field-render-tile PIXELS] [--field-max-pixels N]
                    [--per-filter] [--union-footprint | --no-union-footprint]
                    [--footprint-padding FOOTPRINT_PADDING]
                    [--footprint-tolerance-px FOOTPRINT_TOLERANCE_PX]
                    [--footprint-max-depth FOOTPRINT_MAX_DEPTH]
                    [--max-footprint-pixels MAX_FOOTPRINT_PIXELS]
                    [--overwrite | --no-overwrite] [--device DEVICE]
                    output [inputs ...]

Build a pixelized coadd or fit and render a continuous sky field from FITS observations. Select the workflow with --method coadd or --method field.

positional arguments:
  output                Output FITS path (or directory with --per-filter)
  inputs                Input FITS images (paths or globs); omit with --from-
                        plan

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dry-run             Validate inputs and print planned output shape without
                        writing a map
  --plan-json PATH      Atomically write the resolved map plan before compute
  --from-plan PATH      Replay a validated schema-v2 plan; only output/scratch
                        may change
  --scratch-dir SCRATCH_DIR
                        Scratch location for spillable reducers and large
                        products
  --output-planes {SCI,WHT,IVAR,CTX,MASK,NEXP,NCORR,DQ} [{SCI,WHT,IVAR,CTX,MASK,NEXP,NCORR,DQ} ...]
                        Requested output planes, recorded in plan-v2 (default:
                        SCI WHT IVAR MASK NEXP; CTX and DQ are opt-in)
  --method {coadd,field}
                        coadd: resample+stack; field: fit continuous field
                        then render to grid
  --workflow {native,drizzle,swarp,montage}
                        Calibrated map workflow preset; explicit controls
                        override it
  --hdu HDU             Input image HDU index
  --weights [WEIGHTS ...]
                        Per-input scalar inverse-variance weights; when
                        omitted, unit relative coadd weights do not produce
                        IVAR
  --photometric-scales [PHOTOMETRIC_SCALES ...]
                        Per-input coadd calibration scale applied as scale *
                        (image - background)
  --background-offsets [BACKGROUND_OFFSETS ...]
                        Per-input background offsets; coadd subtracts them,
                        fields model them in rendering
  --background-mode {none,per-exposure,overlap}
                        Background policy; default is selected by --workflow
  --sky-method {mesh,polynomial}
                        Sky model type (default: mesh)
  --sky-statistic {median,huber,tukey}
                        Sky per-cell statistic (default: huber)
  --sky-block-size SKY_BLOCK_SIZE
                        Mesh block size in pixels (mesh method, default: 128)
  --sky-mesh-filter {median,gaussian,none}
                        Mesh post-filter (mesh method, default: median)
  --sky-mesh-filter-size SKY_MESH_FILTER_SIZE
                        Mesh post-filter kernel size (mesh method, default: 3)
  --sky-interpolate {bilinear,bicubic}
                        Mesh-to-image interpolation (mesh method, default:
                        bicubic)
  --sky-order SKY_ORDER
                        Polynomial degree (polynomial method, default: 3)
  --weight-maps [WEIGHT_MAPS ...]
                        Per-input FITS weight maps; multiplied by --weights
                        when set
  --weight-map-hdu WEIGHT_MAP_HDU
                        HDU index for all --weight-maps
  --mask-maps [MASK_MAPS ...]
                        Per-input FITS mask maps; nonzero pixels contribute
  --mask-map-hdu MASK_MAP_HDU
                        HDU index for all --mask-maps
  --dq-maps [DQ_MAPS ...]
                        Per-input DQ bitmask maps; rejected bits follow --dq-
                        policy
  --dq-hdu HDU          HDU name or index for all --dq-maps (default: DQ)
  --good-bits MASK      Bits that must be zero for a pixel to contribute when
                        a mask map is read as a bitmask (instead of a
                        boolean/weight mask)
  --primary-beam-maps [PRIMARY_BEAM_MAPS ...]
                        Per-input primary-beam maps for coadd weighting
  --primary-beam-hdu PRIMARY_BEAM_HDU
                        HDU index for all --primary-beam-maps; default follows
                        torchsky image read
  --reference REFERENCE
                        FITS whose WCS+shape define the output grid
  --reference-hdu REFERENCE_HDU
                        Zero-based image HDU index in --reference (default: 0)
  --plan-reference PLAN_REFERENCE
                        Which input (0-based) defines grid when --reference
                        omitted (coadd/field)
  --stack {weighted_mean,mean,median,sigma_clipped}
                        Stacking after resampling (coadd)
  --clip-sigma CLIP_SIGMA
                        Robust sigma threshold for --stack=sigma_clipped
                        (default: 4)
  --clip-iterations CLIP_ITERATIONS
                        Maximum iterations for --stack=sigma_clipped (default:
                        3)
  --kernel {nearest,bilinear,bicubic,lanczos3,lanczos5,mitchell_netravali,catmull_rom,fft_shift,fft_diagonal_affine,periodic_linear_affine,fft_linear_affine,drizzle_point,drizzle_square,conservative_polygon}
                        Resampling kernel (coadd); drizzle_* uses native
                        forward-drizzle when available
  --drizzle-pixfrac DRIZZLE_PIXFRAC
                        Drizzle pixfrac when using drizzle_* kernels (coadd)
  --value-semantics {surface_brightness,flux}
                        Input pixel value meaning used for area scaling
                        (default: surface_brightness)
  --auto-tile, --no-auto-tile
                        Tile large outputs into spatial chunks (coadd); use
                        --no-auto-tile to disable
  --tile-pixels TILE_PIXELS
                        Force tile height=width in pixels (coadd); implies
                        tiling
  --tile-above-megapixels TILE_ABOVE_MEGAPIXELS
                        With --auto-tile, tile when H×W exceeds this many
                        megapixels (coadd)
  --field-preset {fast,balanced,spectral,operator_constrained}
                        Supported field recipe (default: balanced)
  --field-amp {none,float16,bfloat16}
                        Opt-in CUDA autocast precision with local gradient
                        scaling
  --field-model MODEL   Experimental raw field model kind; overrides --field-
                        preset
  --artifact ARTIFACT   Save a safe resumable field artifact directory
  --resume RESUME       Resume model, optimizer, and RNG state from a field
                        artifact
  --field-band BAND     Filter name for the field bandpass, e.g. F277W
  --field-spectral-source {svo,builtin,file,gaussian}
                        How to set FieldObservation spectral metadata:
                        svo=astroquery SVO FPS (default; needs pip install
                        astroquery), builtin=small JWST table in torchsky,
                        file=two-column wavelength transmission table,
                        gaussian=effective wavelength + min/max (Gaussian
                        sigma from width or --field-gaussian-sigma)
  --svo-facility SVO_FACILITY
                        SVO get_filter_list facility (--field-spectral-
                        source=svo)
  --svo-instrument SVO_INSTRUMENT
                        SVO get_filter_list instrument (--field-spectral-
                        source=svo)
  --svo-filter-id ID    Exact SVO filterID (e.g. JWST/NIRCam.F277W); if set,
                        transmission is downloaded for this ID (--field-band
                        still labels band_name)
  --svo-prefer {classic,2025,any}
                        When multiple SVO rows match a band token, prefer
                        classic vs NIRCam2025
  --svo-cache-dir SVO_CACHE_DIR
                        Directory to cache downloaded SVO filter curves
                        (defaults to $TORCHSKY_SVO_CACHE or
                        ~/.cache/torchsky/svo)
  --no-svo-cache        Disable reading or writing persistent local disk cache
                        for SVO filter profiles
  --field-transmission PATH
                        Two-column wavelength, transmission file (--field-
                        spectral-source=file)
  --field-transmission-dir DIR
                        Directory with {BAND}.txt|dat|csv per filter (--per-
                        filter + file source)
  --field-transmission-unit {angstrom,nm}
                        Wavelength unit in --field-transmission file columns
  --field-gaussian-lambda-eff ANGSTROM
                        Effective wavelength (Å) for gaussian spectral source
  --field-gaussian-lambda-min ANGSTROM
                        Bandpass lower edge (Å) for gaussian spectral source
  --field-gaussian-lambda-max ANGSTROM
                        Bandpass upper edge (Å) for gaussian spectral source
  --field-gaussian-sigma ANGSTROM
                        Gaussian transmission sigma (Å); default from
                        lambda_max-lambda_min FWHM
  --field-quiet-svo     Do not log resolved SVO filterID to stderr
  --field-steps N       Number of field-optimization steps (default: 80)
  --field-lr RATE       Field optimizer learning rate (default: 0.005)
  --field-patch-size PIXELS
                        Training crop size in pixels; 0 = full frame each step
  --field-patches-per-obs N
                        Training patches sampled from each observation per
                        step (default: 2)
  --field-obs-per-step N
                        Observations sampled for each field-optimization step
                        (default: 2)
  --field-spectral-samples N
                        Quadrature samples across each observation passband
                        (default: 9)
  --field-spatial-sampling {center,gauss_legendre_2x2}
                        Detector-pixel sampling for field rendering: center
                        (fast) or gauss_legendre_2x2 (anti-aliased pixel
                        average)
  --field-render-tile PIXELS
                        spatial_tile_hw for render when the field map is
                        larger than this
  --field-max-pixels N  Refuse field rendering if output grid exceeds this
                        many pixels
  --per-filter          Group inputs by FITS FILTER and write one product per
                        filter (coadd and field). Without it, inputs from
                        different filters are rejected.
  --union-footprint, --no-union-footprint
                        Auto-compute output WCS from union bounding box of all
                        input footprints (like SWarp). Use --no-union-
                        footprint to use the first input as reference.
  --footprint-padding FOOTPRINT_PADDING
                        Whole-pixel padding factor for the union footprint
                        (default: 1.0 = exact)
  --footprint-tolerance-px FOOTPRINT_TOLERANCE_PX
                        Maximum curved-WCS boundary chord error in target
                        pixels
  --footprint-max-depth FOOTPRINT_MAX_DEPTH
                        Maximum adaptive boundary subdivision depth; failure
                        is closed
  --max-footprint-pixels MAX_FOOTPRINT_PIXELS
                        Refuse targets exceeding this many pixels (memory
                        guard, coadd/field)
  --overwrite, --no-overwrite
                        Overwrite an existing output file (use --no-overwrite
                        to fail instead)
  --device DEVICE       Tensor device for FITS I/O and map math (e.g. cuda,
                        cuda:1, cpu). Default: CUDA when available else CPU;
                        also settable via TORCHSKY_DEVICE.

Examples:
  torchsky map coadd.fits exposure1.fits exposure2.fits
  torchsky map field.fits exposure*.fits --method field --field-model sine --field-steps 200 --device cuda
```

## `torchsky sky`

```text
usage: torchsky sky [-h] {estimate,match} ...

Estimate detector backgrounds or solve additive offsets across aligned exposures.

positional arguments:
  {estimate,match}
    estimate        Estimate 2D sky background for an image.
    match           Compute additive sky offsets across overlapping exposures.

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit

Examples:
  torchsky sky estimate --help
  torchsky sky match --help
```

## `torchsky sky estimate`

```text
usage: torchsky sky estimate [-h] [--hdu HDU] [--mask MASK]
                             [--mask-hdu MASK_HDU]
                             [--method {mesh,polynomial}]
                             [--statistic {median,huber,tukey}]
                             [--block-size BLOCK_SIZE]
                             [--mesh-filter {median,gaussian,none}]
                             [--mesh-filter-size MESH_FILTER_SIZE]
                             [--interpolate {bilinear,bicubic}]
                             [--order ORDER] [--device DEVICE]
                             image output

Estimate a mesh or polynomial background model from one FITS image.

positional arguments:
  image                 Input FITS image path.
  output                Output FITS path for sky model.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --hdu HDU             Image HDU index.
  --mask MASK           Optional mask FITS (True = exclude).
  --mask-hdu MASK_HDU   Mask HDU index.
  --method {mesh,polynomial}
                        Sky model type (default: mesh).
  --statistic {median,huber,tukey}
                        Per-cell/per-pixel robust statistic (default: huber).
  --block-size BLOCK_SIZE
                        Mesh block size in pixels (mesh method, default: 128).
  --mesh-filter {median,gaussian,none}
                        Mesh post-filter (mesh method, default: median).
  --mesh-filter-size MESH_FILTER_SIZE
                        Mesh post-filter kernel size (mesh method, default:
                        3).
  --interpolate {bilinear,bicubic}
                        Mesh-to-image interpolation (mesh method, default:
                        bicubic).
  --order ORDER         Polynomial degree (polynomial method, default: 3).
  --device DEVICE       Compute device (e.g. cuda, cpu).

Examples:
  torchsky sky estimate input.fits sky.fits
  torchsky sky estimate input.fits sky.fits --method mesh --block-size 64 --device cuda
```

## `torchsky sky match`

```text
usage: torchsky sky match [-h] [--hdu HDU] [--masks [MASKS ...]]
                          [--mask-hdu MASK_HDU] [--output OUTPUT]
                          [--method {mesh,polynomial}]
                          [--statistic {median,huber,tukey}]
                          [--block-size BLOCK_SIZE] [--order ORDER]
                          [--device DEVICE]
                          [--mesh-filter {median,gaussian,none}]
                          [--mesh-filter-size MESH_FILTER_SIZE]
                          [--interpolate {bilinear,bicubic}]
                          images [images ...]

Estimate and optionally apply additive background offsets to aligned FITS images.

positional arguments:
  images                Input FITS images (same pixel grid).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --hdu HDU             Image HDU index.
  --masks [MASKS ...]   Optional per-image masks.
  --mask-hdu MASK_HDU   Mask HDU index.
  --output OUTPUT       Output pattern with {i} (e.g. sky_{i}.fits).
  --method {mesh,polynomial}
                        Sky model type for per-image estimation.
  --statistic {median,huber,tukey}
                        Robust statistic; median is mesh-only (default:
                        huber).
  --block-size BLOCK_SIZE
                        Mesh block size for per-image sky (default: 128).
  --order ORDER         Polynomial degree (polynomial method, default: 3).
  --device DEVICE       Compute device (e.g. cuda, cpu).
  --mesh-filter {median,gaussian,none}
                        Mesh post-filter (mesh method, default: median).
  --mesh-filter-size MESH_FILTER_SIZE
                        Mesh post-filter kernel size (mesh method, default:
                        3).
  --interpolate {bilinear,bicubic}
                        Mesh-to-image interpolation (mesh method, default:
                        bicubic).

Examples:
  torchsky sky match exposure1.fits exposure2.fits
  torchsky sky match exposure*.fits --output corrected_{i}.fits --method polynomial --order 2
```

## `torchsky viz`

```text
usage: torchsky viz [-h] [--root DIR] [--port PORT] [--host HOST]
                    [--no-browser] [--cache-mb MB]
                    [--log-level {critical,error,warning,info,debug}]
                    [--max-registered-surveys N] [--max-validation-pairs N]
                    [--max-image-pixels N] [--expose-health-root]
                    [--cors-origin URL] [--cors-credentials]

Browser-based FITS / sky / validation viewer. Works on localhost and remote clusters (CANFAR, JupyterHub) via HTTPS.

Security: there is no authentication. Only expose --host 0.0.0.0 on trusted networks or behind a reverse proxy. The server can read any file under --root and loads full images into memory for HiPS/validation (see --max-image-pixels and registration caps).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root DIR            Directory to browse (default: current directory).
  --port PORT           HTTP port to listen on (default: 8822).
  --host HOST           Bind address (default: 127.0.0.1). Use 0.0.0.0 for
                        remote access.
  --no-browser          Do not open a browser window automatically.
  --cache-mb MB         PNG tile LRU cache size in MiB (default: 512).
  --log-level {critical,error,warning,info,debug}
                        uvicorn log level (default: warning).
  --max-registered-surveys N
                        Max HiPS surveys kept in memory; oldest dropped when
                        exceeded (default: 64).
  --max-validation-pairs N
                        Max validation registrations; oldest dropped when
                        exceeded (default: 32).
  --max-image-pixels N  Reject HiPS/validation images with H*W above this
                        (default: 512*1024*1024).
  --expose-health-root  Include absolute --root path in /api/health JSON (off
                        by default).
  --cors-origin URL     Allowed CORS origin (repeatable). Default: no cross-
                        origin requests.
  --cors-credentials    Allow credentialed CORS (only with explicit --cors-
                        origin list).

Examples:
  torchsky viz
  torchsky viz --root /data/products --host 0.0.0.0 --no-browser
```
